aboutShort: Senior ML and software engineer with 5+ years of experience building search, retrieval, agentic AI, and distributed backend systems end to end across Python, TypeScript, C# / .NET, Java, and SQL.

At eParts Services, I own search relevance, RAG, MCP servers, and CDC data pipelines for Peregrin—a multi-tenant industrial procurement SaaS platform. Previously, I spent three years at BlackRock engineering Cassandra and Hadoop platforms for Aladdin, and earned my Master of Software Engineering (3.87 GPA) at Carnegie Mellon University.
aboutExtended: Across search, AI agents, and data platforms, my focus is making production systems reliable and cost-effective: fixing 6 silent record-loss defects in a 26M-document Elasticsearch sync, replacing ~48-credit/day per-record Snowflake MERGEs with batched drains (-95% spend), and building a native transactional-outbox workflow engine at ~$40/month instead of a ~$50K/year third-party license.

On the AI side, I take ambiguous problems from prototype to hardened production: benchmarking Azure AI Foundry against LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen, shipping a 42-tool assistant with ReBAC and signed 5-minute action tokens, building a 36-tool OAuth 2.1 MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, and VS Code, and establishing the team's Claude Code harness of skills, subagents, validators, and hooks.

engineeringPrinciples.title: Fix data contracts and ingestion before tuning models
engineeringPrinciples.body: Root-causing 6 sync defects on a 26M-document Elasticsearch index and deduplicating ~400K attachment rows to ~29K unique files delivered more user-visible accuracy than prompt or model changes alone.

engineeringPrinciples.title: Scope agentic permissions and confirm every write
engineeringPrinciples.body: Production agents require relationship-based access control (ReBAC), endpoint-matched OAuth 2.1 permissions, active-page precedence over conversation memory, and signed 5-minute action tokens for user-confirmed writes.

engineeringPrinciples.title: Measure architecture in credits, latency, and eval gates
engineeringPrinciples.body: Every system reports back in concrete metrics: ~95% lower Snowflake CDC spend, 500-bucket aggregations (down from 100,000), 21 ms ETIM classification latency, and weekly CI eval gates backed by redacted production traces.

experience.product: Peregrin — Multi-tenant procurement and product-catalog SaaS platform for industrial parts distributors
experience.summary: Build and own search, retrieval, LLM agents, MCP integrations, event-driven .NET microservices, and Kafka-to-Snowflake CDC pipelines.

highlights.text: Fixed record loss in the product sync for a 26M-document Elasticsearch index by root-causing 6 defects (e.g., 70K+ SKUs in one bulk call) and rebuilding it with keyset pagination, ~1,000-doc / 5 MB chunks, alias swaps with count checks, 15-minute deltas, and 2x write concurrency. Made part-number search tolerant of punctuation and typos for the ~77% of SKUs containing slashes, cutting aggregation size from 100,000 to 500 buckets via tiered exact / normalized / prefix / fuzzy matching and popularity tie-breaks.

Shipped an agentic AI assistant to production users and a customer beta (25/25 on golden evals) by benchmarking Azure AI Foundry against LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen and building 42 strict function-calling tools with ReBAC and signed 5-minute action tokens for human-in-the-loop writes. Removed an ungrounded chat BOM import that caused a High-priority prod bug, scoped 'my orders' to the user's own POs, made the open page outrank conversation memory, added read-only CSV/XLSX row search, and built the post-launch eval loop (~100 redacted conversations/cycle, failure taxonomy, LLM rubric judge, weekly CI PR gate).

highlights.domain: Stateless MCP Server, Browser Agent & Claude Code Harness
highlights.text: Made Peregrin usable from Claude, ChatGPT, and VS Code by building a stateless MCP server (36 tools, 156 tests, OAuth 2.1) with endpoint-matched permissions and audited, user-confirmed writes. Built a TypeScript Chrome/Edge extension agent that searches supplier portals, ranks offers by price, and trims page context to fit token budgets. Authored the team's Claude Code developer guide and agent harness (skills, subagents, validators, hooks).

highlights.domain: Production RAG, eParts Brain & Applied ML
highlights.text: Made ~35K product spec and installation documents (28 GB) answerable at ~98% ingestion success by deduplicating ~400K rows to ~29K unique files in Azure Blob + Azure AI Search. Designed eParts Brain across Granola, Linear, GitHub, and Confluence using Snowflake Cortex Search hybrid retrieval behind a managed MCP server (~$15–30/mo). Directed a CMU team to deliver 382-class ETIM classification (~95% OCR, ~92% class match, 21 ms latency, confidence routing) and framed shipping lead-time prediction (MAE/P90 in MLflow, productionized in Snowflake).

highlights.domain: CDC Streaming, Snowflake Cost (-95%) & Enterprise Data Security
highlights.text: Streamed 436 production SQL Server tables into 2 separate Snowflake instances through 2 consumers reading from the same Debezium + Strimzi Kafka cluster on AKS (Terraform, Helm, GitHub Actions), plus 74 tables from a second database into one of the 2 Snowflakes via a separate consumer (cut over 04/2026) with auto-restart, a 15-minute lag/DLQ watchdog, and fail-closed deploys. Cut Snowflake ingestion spend ~95% (from ~48 credits/day per-record MERGEs to batched MERGEs executing 500K+ rows/run in ~1 hour with auto-suspend). Took Siemens live on the 74-table (~2.1M-row) CDC feed with zero pricing exposure, and protected 18 sensitive SQL Server tables with dynamic data masking.

highlights.domain: Backend Microservices, Schema Migration & Workflow Engine
highlights.text: Shipped the .NET email and notification service in 3 weeks (Hangfire, SignalR across 3–10 replicas via Azure SignalR, SendGrid, PostgreSQL) and closed a cross-workspace data leak. Led the KOBA Azure Service Bus pricing service, the v5 schema migration, and a partitioned tenant-pricing table for billions of rows. Built a native transactional-outbox workflow engine at ~$40/mo (signed webhooks, loop/SSRF guards), avoiding a ~$50K/yr n8n license and 2026 RCE.
